$comment: Licence policy for what the Prism Client ships (generate.mjs). A licence id that is not in `allowed` or `listed` FAILS the build, so a new dependency cannot bring an unreviewed licence in. `denied` names the copyleft families that are never shipped. `packages` overrides a component's declared licence; every entry needs a reason. Keys: crate:<name>[@<version>] or npm:<name>[@<version>].

allowed.Apache-2.0: permissive (patent grant); NOTICE files are reproduced
allowed.OFL-1.1: SIL Open Font License: fonts may be bundled with software; not sold on their own

listed.MPL-2.0: file-level copyleft: used unmodified, source available upstream; listed in the file
listed.EPL-2.0: file-level copyleft: used unmodified, source available upstream; listed in the file

exceptions.LLVM-exception: the LLVM exception to Apache-2.0 (no attribution needed for compiled forms)

npm:@excalidraw/excalidraw.reason: declared in package.json; the npm package ships no licence file — https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/blob/master/LICENSE). Its build bundles the Assistant font, which the native web build copies into the app; the other Excalidraw fonts load from a CDN at run time and are not shipped.

npm:khroma@2.1.0.reason: package.json declares no licence; the package's `license` file is the MIT License (Copyright (c) 2019-present Fabio Spampinato, Andrew Maney). Reached through mermaid. Pinned to this version so a new one is reviewed again.
